takeaway: Courvoisier's law: a palpable gallbladder with jaundice is more likely malignancy, such as carcinoma of the head of the pancreas, than gallstones.

question.text: A 65-year-old woman has malaise, grumbling abdominal pain and looks a little yellow. A mass is felt in the right upper quadrant. What is the likely diagnosis?
question.say: A sixty-five-year-old woman has general malaise and grumbling abdominal pain. Her daughter thinks she looks a little yellow. A mass is felt in the right upper quadrant. What is the likely diagnosis?

answer.say: The answer is carcinoma of the head of the pancreas.
